# laravelforge_site_reverb (Resource)

Manages the Laravel Reverb integration on a Forge site. The integration is a singleton per site; there is no update endpoint, so changing any input recreates it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connections` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent connections (1-50000). Changing it recreates the integration.
- `host` (String) Reverb host. Changing it recreates the integration.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `port` (String) Reverb port. Changing it recreates the integration.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site to enable Reverb on.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Reverb integration is enabled, as reported by Forge.
- `installed_connections` (Number) Maximum concurrent connections as reported by Forge.
- `installed_host` (String) Reverb host as reported by Forge.
- `installed_port` (Number) Reverb port as reported by Forge.
- `reverb_installed` (Boolean) Whether the Reverb package is installed on the site.
